Benign prostatic hyperplasia: Benign prostatic hyperplasia is a nonmalignant enlargement of the prostate gland commonly associated with lower urinary tract symptoms in aging men.
Prostate cancer: Prostate cancer is a malignant neoplasm of the prostate gland characterized by uncontrolled cellular proliferation, often driven by androgen receptor signaling, and associated with genetic and epigenetic alterations that contribute to tumor initiation, progression, and clinical heterogeneity.
Cystoscopy: Cystoscopy is an endoscopic examination of the urinary bladder and urethra using a cystoscope.
Nephrolithiasis: Nephrolithiasis is the presence of calculi in the kidney.
